36:3: Surely you are of those who have been sent.
36:5: It is the sending down of the al-Aziz, the al-Rahim.
36:6: That you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
36:7: Certainly the word has proved true against most of them, so they do not believe.
36:8: Surely We have placed iron collars upon their necks, and they are up to the chins, so their heads are held up.
36:9: And We have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them, so they cannot see.
36:10: It is the same to them whether you warn them or do not warn them; they do not believe.
36:11: You only warn whoever follows the remembrance and fears the al-Rahman in the unseen; give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a noble reward.
36:12: Surely We give life to the dead and write what they have sent ahead and their traces, and We count everything in a clear book.
36:13: And give them the example of the people of that town, when the messengers came to them.
36:14: When We sent to them two, then because they denied them, We reinforced them with a third, whereupon they said: We are indeed sent to you.
36:15: They said: You are only humans like us. The al-Rahman has sent down nothing. You are only lying.
36:16: They said: Our Rabb knows that we are surely sent to you.
36:17: And there is nothing upon us except the clear conveyance.
36:18: They said: We have seen an evil omen in you. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and a painful punishment will touch you from us.
36:19: They said: Is your evil omen with you if you are warned? No, but you are a people who are extravagant.
36:20: A man came running from the farthest part of the city; he said: O my people, follow the messengers.
36:21: Follow those who do not ask you for any fee, and they are guided to the right way.
36:22: Why should I not worship the One Who created me, and to Him you will be returned.
36:23: Shall I take deities besides Him? If the al-Rahman should intend any harm for me, their intercession would not benefit me at all, nor could they save me.
36:24: Surely I would then be in clear error.
36:25: Surely I have believed in your Rabb, so listen to me.
36:26: It was said: Enter Paradise. He said: If only my people knew,
36:27: Because of my Rabb's forgiving me and making me of those who are honored.
36:28: And after him We did not send down upon his people an army from heaven, nor were We senders down.
36:29: It was nothing but a single cry, and behold, they were extinguished.
36:30: Alas for those servants! No messenger ever came to them except that they mocked him.
36:31: Did they not see how many generations We destroyed before them? They do not return to them.
36:32: And surely all of them, gathered together, will be brought into Our presence.
36:33: And a sign for them is the dead land: We gave it life and brought forth grains from it, and from it they eat.
36:34: And We placed therein gardens of date palms and grapes, and We caused springs to gush forth in it,
36:35: So that they may eat of its fruits and what their hands have made. Will they still not be grateful?
36:36: Exalted is He Who created all the pairs from what the earth grows, from their own selves, and from what they do not know.
36:37: And a sign for them is the night: We strip from it the day, and behold, they are left in darkness.
36:38: And the sun runs toward a resting place for it; that is the determination of Allah, the al-Aziz, the All-Knowing.
36:39: And for the moon We determined stages, until it becomes like the old date branch.
36:40: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor for the night to outstrip the day; each swims in an orbit.
36:41: And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship.
36:42: And We created for them the like of it, things they ride.
36:43: And if We willed, We would drown them; then there would be no helper for them, nor could they be saved,
36:44: Except as a mercy from Us and a provision for a determined time.
36:45: And when it is said to them, Beware of what is before you and what is behind you so that you may receive mercy, they turn away.
36:46: And not a single sign comes to them from the signs of their Rabb but that they are turning away from it.
36:47: And when it is said to them, Spend of what Allah has provided you, those who disbelieve say to those who believe: Shall we feed someone whom Allah would have fed if He had willed? You are only in clear error.
36:48: And they say: When is this promise, if you are truthful?
36:49: They await nothing but a single cry to seize them while they are disputing.
36:50: Then they will neither be able to make a bequest, nor will they be able to return to their families.
36:51: And the Sur is blown, whereupon they run from the graves toward their Rabb.
36:52: They say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping place? This is what the al-Rahman promised and the messengers spoke the truth.
36:53: It is nothing but a single cry, whereupon they will all together be brought present before Us.
36:54: Today no soul will be wronged in anything, and you will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
36:55: Surely the companions of Paradise on that day are occupied in enjoyment.
36:56: They and their spouses are in shades, reclining upon couches.
36:57: For them therein are fruits, and for them is whatever they desire.
36:58: Peace, as a word from a Rabb who is Rahim.
36:60: O children of Adam, did I not covenant with you: Do not worship Satan; surely he is a clear enemy to you,
36:61: And worship Me; this is the straight path.
36:62: And certainly he led astray many generations from you; will you still not use your reason?
36:63: This is the Hell that you were promised.
36:64: Enter it today because of what you used to disbelieve.
36:65: Today We set a seal upon their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to what they used to earn.
36:66: And if We willed, We would have obliterated their eyes, so they would race for the way; how then could they see?
36:67: And if We willed, We would have transformed their forms in their place, so they could neither go forward nor return.
36:68: And to whomever We give long life, We reverse him in creation. Will they still not reason?
36:69: And We did not teach him poetry, and it was not suitable for him. It is only a reminder and a clear Quran,
36:70: To warn whoever is alive, and that the word may prove true against the disbelievers.
36:71: Did they not see that We created livestock for them from what Our hands have made, so that they are owners of them?
36:72: And We subjected them to them, so from them are their mounts and from them they eat.
36:73: And for them in them are benefits and drinks; will they still not be grateful?
36:74: And they took deities besides Allah so that perhaps they might be helped.
36:75: They cannot help them; and they are an army waiting ready for them.
36:76: So let not their speech grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they declare.
36:77: Has man not seen that We created him from a nutfah, that he becomes an open adversary?
36:78: And he gave Us an example and forgot his creation. He said: Who will revive the bones, and they are decayed?
36:79: Say: He Who created them the first time will revive them, and He is the Knower of every creation.
36:80: He Who made for you fire from the green tree, and thus you kindle from it.
36:81: Is not the One Who created the heavens and the earth capable of creating the like of them? Yes, He is the One Who creates abundantly, the All-Knowing.
36:82: Surely His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it 'Be!', and it immediately becomes.
36:83: Exalted is He in Whose hand is the malakut (dominion) of everything, and to Him you will be returned.
